description: The bar chart, titled "Mapping the Minds of LLMs: A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM," illustrates the token count for two distinct categories—Reasoning and Demonstration—across five different groups, labeled 0 through 4 on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled "Token Count," ranges from 0 to 7000, with major gridlines at intervals of 1000. Each group is represented by a stacked bar, with the lower, orange portion representing the "Reasoning" category and the upper, blue portion representing the "Demonstration" category. The total token count for each group is shown as a numerical label on the bar: Group 0 has a total of 6393 tokens (all Reasoning), Group 1 has 4444 tokens (4292 Reasoning, 152 Demonstration), Group 2 has 4762 tokens (4599 Reasoning, 163 Demonstration), Group 3 has 5380 tokens (5040 Reasoning, 340 Demonstration), and Group 4 has 5002 tokens (4223 Reasoning, 779 Demonstration). Additionally, red downward-pointing arrows with numerical labels indicate a negative value for each group: -1952 for Group 1, -1613 for Group 2, -1040 for Group 3, and -1379 for Group 4, suggesting a comparison or difference from a baseline. The chart uses a legend at the top to differentiate the two categories by color.
